summary: Iteration 17 — validated new per-scenario overrides in BudgetFicheDialog (department, employment_type, employment_rate). Backend pytest 8/8 PASS. Frontend Playwright PASS. Environment left pristine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/employees/{eid} requires the FULL EmployeeBase payload; a partial PATCH-style update would be more forgiving (found while restoring dept during test cleanup).

server.py:912 uses `f"{y}"` (string) in the mongo dotted key which is correct — but the fact that `years.{year}` is stored under str(year) elsewhere means any future refactor must keep this consistent.

compute_budget (server.py ~271): when scenario override sets employment_type='Régulier temps partiel', ccq becomes False and aug switches from aug_ccq to aug_autres. This is intentional per spec but not obvious — a code comment would help future maintainers.
No GET /api/employees/{eid} endpoint — must fetch entire list to read one employee (minor DX concern).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All overrides created during tests were reset to {} in try/finally. Locks toggled ON then OFF. First-employee ('Poste vacant' dept 020) had its department overwritten by an initial failing test run — restored via full-body PUT to '020' (verified). Employee count check now uses >=122 (actual count in DB is 123 — matches iteration_16 note that 122 was the request assumption; existing DB carries 123 records — flagged to main agent to reconcile).

verified_scenarios.backend_per_scenario_isolation: PASS — override on ca (dept 810, part-time 0.5) shows department_label 'Électriciens', ~50% new_salary; revue1 for same employee UNCHANGED.
verified_scenarios.backend_part_time_proration: PASS — at rate=0.5 new_salary is ~half of rate=1 preview; alloc scales; total_budgeted strictly lower.
verified_scenarios.backend_dept_change_csst_invariant: PASS — CSST identical before/after department-only override (still based on employee security_class).
verified_scenarios.backend_lock_propagates_department: PASS — locking revue2 with override dept X copied X into employee.department; unlock + reset override + full-body PUT restored original.
verified_scenarios.backend_role_permissions: PASS — viewer 403 on override, editor 200 on override (unlocked), editor 403 on /budget/lock.
verified_scenarios.frontend_fiche_dialog: PASS — fiche-emploi-section shows fiche-employment-type (4 options: CCQ, Régulier temps plein, Régulier temps partiel, Stagiaire) and fiche-department (17 depts). Selecting 'Régulier temps partiel' reveals fiche-employment-rate. Changing rate 100→50 dropped 'Nouveau salaire' from 166 381 $ to 91 324 $. Scenario tabs fiche-scenario-ca/revue1/revue2 present and independent (revue1 shows 166 381 $ full-time).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE URL from /app/frontend/.env. Overrides endpoint: PUT /api/employees/{eid}/budget-override?year=&scenario=  body {override:{department,employment_type,employment_rate,...}}; empty {} resets. Lock endpoint: POST /api/budget/lock {year,scenario,locked}. When locked=true, employee.department is overwritten by scenario override department (per-scenario→employee record propagation). CSST always uses employee.security_class × class_rate — never department. When employment_type is set to 'Régulier temps partiel' via override, ccq becomes False for that scenario (so prime CCQ disappears and aug uses aug_autres). Restoration of an employee record REQUIRES full EmployeeBase body via PUT — a partial body will fail Pydantic validation. There are 123 employees in the DB (not 122 as review request assumed).
